scripts.release: npm run release:dossier && npm run release:noperi
scripts.release:dossier: docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64,linux/arm64 --target production -t sanjeevstunner/dossier:$npm_package_version -t sanjeevstunner/dossier:latest --push dossier-dev
scripts.release:noperi: docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64,linux/arm64 -t sanjeevstunner/noperi:$npm_package_version -t sanjeevstunner/noperi:latest --push noperi-ts
